text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the theme of the Arima Kinen is 
revealed from the mouth of T.M. Opera O 
herself— and that theme is the "Clash of 
Generations."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road's generation—the Dream 
Generation—now possesses strength rivaling 
that of the Golden Generation. If that is 
so, she says, then they ought to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing the "way" by defeating the Golden 
Generation... As everyone spoke of their 
own paths, Narita Top Road, guided by her 
Trainer's advice, showcased the "path of 
diligence."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet, 'hard work' was only one part of 
her. Together, they looked back on the 
path they had walked, and dreamed of the 
road that lay ahead of them."
